title: CodeAtlas Feature Schema
description: Schema defining a semantic, user-visible feature within the codebase.

description.description: A semantic, user-centric description of what the feature does.

location_context.description: Where the user encounters this feature (e.g., 'Homepage top section', 'Global Navigation Header').

user_visible_purpose.description: The value or goal this feature provides to the end-user.

user_interactions.description: Specific actions the user can take on or with this feature.

primary_files.description: Key files that implement the primary logic or UI for this feature.

supporting_files.description: Related files that provide components, helpers, or hooks to this feature.

data_dependencies.description: Data models, APIs, endpoints, or query structures this feature relies on.

state_dependencies.description: Stores, contexts, or local state controllers governing this feature's state.

related_features.description: IDs of other semantically related features in the codebase.

aliases.description: Natural-language synonyms or user-facing terms that should resolve to this feature during lookup (e.g., 'saved artwork', 'my posters').

keywords.description: Core vocabulary tokens that describe the feature concept (e.g., 'saved', 'poster', 'collection').

evidence.description: Optional structured provenance supporting this feature mapping.

file.description: Repository-relative file path referenced by this evidence.

symbol.description: Relevant exported symbol or identifier, when available.

lines.description: Optional line range; fields may be omitted if line numbers are unknown or stale.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of why this evidence supports the mapping.

confidence.description: The semantic mapping accuracy confidence level.

notes.description: Developer or agent observations, caveats, or implementation queries.
